name: agent-diff-auditor
description: Catches the shortcuts AI coding agents take to look done: skipped or deleted tests, weakened assertions, suppressed errors and softened CI.

diffAuditor.baseRef.description: Git ref to compare the working tree against. Use e.g. 'main' to audit everything on a branch.

diffAuditor.includeUntracked.description: Also audit new files that git does not track yet (agents often add new test files).

diffAuditor.ignoreRules.description: Rule ids to turn off, for example 'suppression-added'.

diffAuditor.autoAudit.description: Re-run the audit shortly after every file save.

languageModelTools.name: diffAuditor_auditChanges
languageModelTools.userDescription: Scan uncommitted changes for shortcuts such as skipped tests, weakened assertions and suppressed errors.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Scans the git diff of the current workspace for shortcuts that make a task look finished without actually being finished: deleted or skipped tests, removed or weakened assertions, newly added @ts-ignore / eslint-disable / noqa suppressions, empty catch blocks and CI checks that were softened. Call it before telling the user a task is done, and fix or explicitly justify every finding it reports.

baseRef.description: Optional git ref to diff against. Defaults to the configured base ref (HEAD).
